name: com.chillyairllc/products
title: Chilly Air Products
description: Read-only Chilly Air LLC HVAC product catalog for AI agents. No orders or customer data.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List published Chilly Air products (WooCommerce) with SKU, categories, availability, listed price where the site shows one, shipping summary and how each item is ordered (online checkout or freight quote). Refrigerants are separate: use list_refrigerants.

category.description: Category slug from list_categories, e.g. air-handlers.

purchasable_online.description: Only items a person can buy through online checkout.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Keyword search over product name, SKU, short description and category (all words must match). Also returns matching refrigerants (quote only).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full published details for one product by numeric id, SKU or URL slug: description, attributes, weight/dimensions if published, images, price/ordering and shipping. Only data published on the product page; no invented specs.

product.description: Product id, SKU (e.g. DHP5036E1000A) or slug.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Product categories with slugs, parent category, product counts and URLs (includes the quote-only Refrigerants line).

tools.name: list_refrigerants
tools.description: Refrigerants Chilly Air supplies, with type, available sizes, spec page URL and ordering terms. Quote only: contact for pricing.

tools.name: get_shipping_policy
tools.description: Shipping regions, rates, lead times and freight rules, the refund and returns policy (text as published), and how orders and quotes work.

tools.name: get_quote_link
tools.description: Phone, text, email and contact-page links for a quote. Pass a product id, SKU or slug to get a pre-filled email subject (and the add-to-cart link if the item is sold online). Does not send anything.

product.description: Optional product id, SKU or slug.
